title: FRED Money Supply and Liquidity
description: Tracks M2 money supply, the Fed's balance sheet (WALCL), overnight reverse repo (RRPONTSYD), and the Fed Funds rate. M2 expansion is the single best predictor of asset price inflation - when the money printer runs, asset prices follow with a 6-12 month lag. Reverse repo drawdowns signal liquidity re-entering the system. Fed balance sheet shrinkage (QT) is bearish for risk assets.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'
API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

SERIES = [
    ('M2SL', 'm2_money_supply', 'M2 Money Supply (billions)'),
    ('WALCL', 'fed_balance_sheet', 'Fed Total Assets (millions)'),
    ('RRPONTSYD', 'reverse_repo', 'Overnight Reverse Repo (billions)'),
    ('FEDFUNDS', 'fed_funds_rate', 'Effective Federal Funds Rate'),
    ('BOGMBASE', 'monetary_base', 'St. Louis Adjusted Monetary Base (billions)'),
]

rows = []
for i in range(len(SERIES)):
    series_id = SERIES[i][0]
    label = SERIES[i][1]
    description = SERIES[i][2]

    resp = requests.get(
        BASE,
        params={
            'series_id': series_id,
            'api_key': API_KEY,
            'file_type': 'json',
            'sort_order': 'desc',
            'limit': 13,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    obs = resp.json().get('observations', [])

    valid = []
    for o in obs:
        if o.get('value', '.') != '.':
            valid.append(o)

    if not valid:
        continue

    latest = float(valid[0]['value'])
    prev = float(valid[1]['value']) if len(valid) >= 2 else latest
    change_pct = round(((latest - prev) / prev) * 100, 4) if prev != 0 else 0.0

    yoy_change_pct = 0.0
    if len(valid) >= 13:
        year_ago = float(valid[12]['value'])
        yoy_change_pct = round(((latest - year_ago) / year_ago) * 100, 2) if year_ago != 0 else 0.0

    # Liquidity signal
    if label == 'm2_money_supply':
        signal = 'EXPANDING' if yoy_change_pct > 0 else 'CONTRACTING'
    elif label == 'fed_balance_sheet':
        signal = 'QE_MODE' if change_pct > 0 else 'QT_MODE'
    elif label == 'reverse_repo':
        signal = 'DRAINING_TO_MARKETS' if change_pct < -5 else 'ABSORBING_LIQUIDITY'
    elif label == 'fed_funds_rate':
        if latest > 5.0:
            signal = 'RESTRICTIVE'
        elif latest > 3.0:
            signal = 'MODERATELY_TIGHT'
        elif latest > 1.0:
            signal = 'NEUTRAL'
        else:
            signal = 'ACCOMMODATIVE'
    else:
        signal = 'EXPANDING' if change_pct > 0 else 'CONTRACTING'

    rows.append({
        'series_id': series_id,
        'metric': label,
        'description': description,
        'latest_value': latest,
        'latest_date': valid[0].get('date', ''),
        'period_change_pct': change_pct,
        'yoy_change_pct': yoy_change_pct,
        'liquidity_signal': signal,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
